note: Wardrobe of the stage runner (see docs/operations.md, „Bühnenlauf: Garderobe“). Role figures (roleFigures): every stage role of an actor (person × play × role) is an item of its own with role, play and year and its own rarity, chosen from the role's importance in its play (importance 0–100: gold ≥ 85, red ≥ 70, pink ≥ 50, blue ≥ 25, else light blue; source: the rarity proposal of 24.10.2026). Technicians are one figure each across all plays (rarity technik, crew: role is their function, no play or year); former members are legacy. variantOf names the person's figure that apps before role figures show this role as a variant of. Legacy joins the draw once requires.count light blue characters are owned and stays open from then on. A crate first draws a rarity by its weight (among rarities with items left to win), then one of its items uniformly. Items with "placeholder": true have no picture of their own yet and tint the default art; a listed image or preview that does not exist in images/ is simply ignored; disabled: true waits for its picture. A person without a single active figure (new members without a picture yet) is not in the catalog at all, not even disabled.

dupes.note: Duplicates (runnerDupes): a rarity drawn by its weight that is complete gives a duplicate: its shine if the draw shines and it has none, else the rarity's gage (roles are figures of their own, no variant step). shinyChance per draw by crate kind (costume = crates of the own metres, ensemble, event = Termin-Kiste for an own commitment, further kinds may be added; a kind not listed has the costume chance); a trade costs tradeDupes duplicates of the rarity below its target, a chosen item buyDupes duplicates of its rarity (not where buyable is false).

ensemble.note: Ensemble-Strecke (runnerEnsemble): the metres of all players together. Each milestone (km) unlocks its reward item (reward: true) for everybody once its picture is there, and gives every active member one Ensemble-Kiste (shine chance dupes.shinyChance.ensemble); after the last listed one a milestone with just the crate every `every` km.
